title: Boogey Assist
description: Addon for the Life Series Mod that adds a timer to the Boogeyman, with automatic success and fail!
body:
Addon for [Life Series Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/life-series) that adds a handy timer that manages the Boogeyman sucess and fail mechanics!


## SETUP
Setup is as easy as pie! To start with, give everyone you want to be able to control the settings of the Datapack the "mod" tag with this command:

```
/tag <targets> add mod
```
Next, open the life series config and find the "Events" tab.

```
/lifeseries config
```
Scroll down until you find "Boogeyman Cure" and type the following inside the text box beside it:

```
/function boogey:cured
```
![Here's what it should look like:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9431f94921663d1fc3356ff9191de9fbd0e261f2_0.webp)

Once you're done with that, the Datapack should be up and running!

The setup information can also be seen when first loading the Datapack onto your world.

![Setup Information](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34a1be1c6d7e3a9592c4d0e463f5da907bcc9b8a.png)




## COMMANDS
There aren't many commands in this Datapack, but they're worth mentioning:

- /trigger boogeyhelp - Opens the settings
- /trigger boogeyman - Opens the Boogeymen summoning screen

> The setup screen will only stop appearing after reload _only when you open the settings menu!_

![Boogeyman Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1aa934b0b070c51622084a367dcf070423de038.png)
- Cancel Boogeys: Clears all Boogeymen and stops the timer
- Fail Early: Fails all Boogeymen early

Feel free to use this Datapack for any of your Minirounds or Life Series Sessions! Although, any credits on videos uploaded with this pack (if there are any at all lmao) would be greatly appreciated :P

That's all! Thanks for reading!
